title_sq: PER SHITJE APARTAMENT 3+1+2+ 1 POST PARKIMI TEK BULEVARDI I RI !
description_sq:
PER SHITJE APARTAMENT 3+1+2+ 1 POST PARKIMI TEK BULEVARDI I RI !
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 9te jo te fundit te nje pallati te ri ne Bulevardin e Ri. Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 156.3 m 2 dhe organizohet nga 3 dhoma gjumi, korridor shperndares, 2 tualete, 2 ballkone, sallon dhe ambient gatimi i bollshem me dritare dhe dalje ne ballkon. Ka orientim Lindje - Perendim dhe fushepamje te lire. Pallati eshte i pajisur me 2 ashensore cilesore dhe ka vetem 6 apartamente ne kat, me shkalle dhe ambiente te perbashketa me ndricim natyral.
Tualetet jane shtruar me pllaka dhe pajisje hidrosanitare me kosto extra nga pronari.
Apartamenti disponon dhe nje post parkimi te bollshem dhe ne nje pozicion shume te favorshem afer ashensorit dhe daljes ne katin -2.
Ne pallat ka filluar banimi.
Per me shume informacion apo nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni ! Gold130640
title_en: FOR SALE APARTMENT 3+1+2+ 1 PARKING POST ON THE NEW BULEVARD!
description_en: FOR SALE APARTMENT 3+1+2+ 1 PARKING POST ON THE NEW BULEVARD! The apartment is located on the 9th floor of a new building on Ri Boulevard. The apartment has a total area of ​​156.3 m 2 and is organized by 3 bedrooms, distribution corridor, 2 toilets, 2 balconies, living room and spacious kitchen with windows and access to the balcony. It has an East-West orientation and a clear field of view. The building is equipped with 2 quality elevators and there are only 6 apartments on the floor, with stairs and common areas with natural lighting. The toilets are laid with tiles and hydrosanitary equipment at extra cost from the owner. The apartment also has an ample parking space and in a very favorable position near the elevator and the exit to the -2nd floor. Housing has started in the building. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us! Gold130640
